items.title_en: Student Asks AI For Help In The Middle Of An Exam, Gets Unexpected Rejection; Internet Says 'What Is This B
items.title_zh: 学生在考试中向 AI 寻求帮助，意外遭到拒绝；互联网上说“这是什么 B”
items.summary_en: A viral LinkedIn post showing ChatGPT refusing to answer a student's live exam question has sparked amusement, with users sharing jokes and witty takes on AI ethics
items.summary_zh: LinkedIn 上一篇疯传的帖子显示，ChatGPT 拒绝回答学生的现场考试问题，引发了一阵搞笑，用户们分享了有关人工智能道德的笑话和诙谐的看法
